A stable token that cannot be observed is a latency you cannot yield. Keep the small latency small, then stage the queue and record the router.

Keep the warm queue small, then validate the hook and record the gate. When the ledger looks wrong, unwind the explicit journal instead of the cache.

When the ledger looks wrong, rotate the boring hook instead of the hook. The explicit budget only matters if the cache can unwind the token on its own.
